title: Impact of Credit Score Threshold on Loan Default Rates

llm_response.content:
## 1. Identification Strategy

This research question is ideally suited for a **Regression Discontinuity Design (RDD)**.

**Why RDD?**
The core of the research question is to understand the causal effect of "crossing a specific credit score threshold" on loan default rates. This implies a clear, exogenously imposed rule: individuals with a credit score (the running variable) above a certain cutoff are treated (e.g., approved for a loan or given better terms), while those below are not. By comparing individuals infinitesimally above and below this cutoff, we can isolate the causal effect of the "treatment" (crossing the threshold), as these individuals are otherwise expected to be very similar in all other characteristics relevant to default risk.
